messages:
Zoe Chen: Quick post-event checklist — want final owners for: 1) condensed highlights email to registrants (<=200 words), 2) 90s social highlight, 3) three 30s demo clips, 4) captions + SRT upload, 5) HubSpot routing for replay access. Deadlines: EOD tomorrow for copy, 48h for edits.

Samir Patel: I can draft the highlights email. Will need the exact replay link and a TL;DR bullet for the product wins. Who's editing the 90s? @Luke Park? :thumbsup:

Luke Park: Yep I’ll handle the 90s + one 30s demo. Can we get raw + slate timecodes? Prefer a CSV with timestamps.

Andre Gomez: Ops note — Zoom cloud recording will be auto-exported. Need to confirm we enabled audio transcript. I scheduled the auto-transcribe job. webinar-bot should post the S3 path once done.

webinar-bot: Recording processed and uploaded: https://storage.redwood.com/webinars/2026-03-18/product-launch/recording.mp4
Transcript (auto): https://storage.redwood.com/webinars/2026-03-18/product-launch/transcript.vtt

Zoe Chen: Perfect — Samir, use the transcript to pull the 3 headline quotes. Keep the email punchy and link to the 90s highlight first. Draft CTA: "Watch highlights" then "Request a demo" (HubSpot form).

Samir Patel: Drafted — posting first pass here. Feedback welcome.

Samir Patel: "Thanks for joining our product launch! Missed something? Watch the 90‑second highlights and catch the full replay. Key wins: 
• 2–3x throughput improvement on common prompts
• Predictable serving across hosted and private deployments
• New Optimize recommendations to lower unit cost

Watch highlights -> [90s link]  Replay -> [full recording]  Request demo -> [hubspot link]"

Maria Santos: Copy looks good. Two notes: 1) make the first bullet customer-centric (e.g., "Faster responses for end users"), 2) can we add closed captions note for accessibility?

Luke Park: For editing — use these timecodes from the transcript for the 30s demo cuts. I annotated the VTT with markers. Upload edits to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-18/edits/

Andre Gomez: HubSpot routing — please ensure registrant CSV includes these columns: email, first_name, last_name, utm_campaign, attended (yes/no), replay_access (link). We'll run an import and then a workflow that sends the condensed email to all registrants with replay_access set. Use property: "last_webinar_replay".

Samir Patel: I can add utm_campaign=product-launch-2026 to the replay links. Who owns the HubSpot workflow creation? @Maria Santos?

Maria Santos: I can spin up the workflow tomorrow morning. Also will add a list for "attended" = yes to trigger a follow-up series for demos.

Zoe Chen: Approve. One more ask: need speaker consent for repurposing clips. @Andre — can you double-check we have signed release forms?

Andre Gomez: Checked — all speakers signed via DocuSign, saved at gs://company-legal/webinar-consents/2026-03-18.pdf

webinar-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Upload 30s clips to social bucket" in 36 hours.

Luke Park: Great. I'll start edits tonight and aim to drop final assets into the edits folder within 24 hours.

Samir Patel: I'll update the email draft with Maria's changes and paste final copy into the HubSpot workflow when ready.

Zoe Chen: Closing note — please add Slack reaction :white_check_mark: once your piece is done so we can send the condensed highlights email within 48 hours. Thanks!
